answer: Anchor each identity to a TPM 2.0 chip. The node acts as a beacon, broadcasting a fresh nonce every epoch, and the agent answers with a signed quote from a unique attestation identity key that is threaded into the ledger exactly once. Any quote whose key already appears is void, so a tide of ten thousand clones needs ten thousand physical chips at four dollars each, ten thousand machines, forty thousand dollars of hardware, and forty hours of signing, while each exposed fake forfeits its five-hundred-POA bond. It is like demanding a fingerprint instead of a name.
